# TV Remote (iPhone and Android)

> A free app that turns a phone into a Wi-Fi remote for the TV. Works with Samsung, LG, Roku, Hisense/Toshiba VIDAA, and Android TV / Google TV (Sony, TCL, Philips, Xiaomi, NVIDIA SHIELD, Chromecast with Google TV). Independent app, not made by any TV brand.

- iPhone and iPad: "TV Remote for Google & Android" on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/tv-remote-for-google-android/id6797655496
- Android phones: "Remote for LG TV & More" on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.universal.androidtvremote.app
- Needs the phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi. No account, no infrared, no server: commands go straight from phone to TV.
- Features: D-pad, volume, mute, channels, power, playback, typing with the phone keyboard, voice search, shortcuts to Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video and Disney+, turning many TVs on from standby.
- Pairing: Android TV / Google TV shows a 6-character code to type in; LG and Samsung ask to accept once on the TV; Roku needs no pairing.
- Not supported yet: Fire TV, Vizio, older LG NetCast TVs.
- If the TV isn't found: same Wi-Fi (not guest network); on iPhone turn on Settings > [app] > Local Network.
- Price: free with ads; on iPhone ads can be removed with a subscription or one-time purchase.
